description: AnsibleAI RAG evaluation dataset — 20 queries covering all collections

samples.question: execute a shell command inside a running kubernetes pod
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_exec module with required parameters: command, namespace, and pod. It should run on localhost with connection local.

samples.question: scale a deployment named analytics-backend to 3 replicas in the production namespace
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_scale module with replicas: 3, name: analytics-backend, namespace: production, kind: Deployment, api_version: apps/v1.

samples.question: deploy nginx using helm chart in the monitoring namespace with release name nginx-ingress
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.helm module with chart_ref, release_name: nginx-ingress, release_namespace: monitoring, and state: present.

samples.question: copy a configuration file from local machine to a kubernetes pod in the default namespace
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_cp module with local_path, remote_path, pod, namespace: default parameters.

samples.question: get logs from a pod named api-server in the backend namespace
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_log module with name: api-server, namespace: backend. Logs are returned in the result.

samples.question: drain a kubernetes node named worker-01 for maintenance ignoring daemonsets
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_drain module with name: worker-01, delete_options.ignore_daemonsets: true, and state: drain.

samples.question: create a kubernetes secret named db-credentials with username and password using stringData
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s module with kind: Secret, api_version: v1, and stringData containing username and password fields.

samples.question: deploy an analytics backend deployment with 3 replicas using existing ConfigMap analytics-config and Secret analytics-db-secret
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s with kind: Deployment, replicas: 3, and envFrom containing both configMapRef name: analytics-config and secretRef name: analytics-db-secret inside the container spec.

samples.question: get information about all pods in the kube-system namespace
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_info module with kind: Pod, namespace: kube-system. Results are registered for further use.

samples.question: rollback a helm release named prometheus in the monitoring namespace
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.helm_rollback or kubernetes.core.k8s_rollback module targeting the prometheus release in the monitoring namespace.

samples.question: create an EC2 instance of type t3.micro in us-east-1 region with tag Name=webserver
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use amazon.aws.ec2_instance module with instance_type: t3.micro, region: us-east-1, and tags.Name: webserver. Requires AWS credentials.

samples.question: create an S3 bucket named my-app-backups in us-west-2 with versioning enabled
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use amazon.aws.s3_bucket module with name: my-app-backups, region: us-west-2, and versioning: true.

samples.question: create an IAM user named ci-deployer with programmatic access
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use amazon.aws.iam_user module with name: ci-deployer and state: present.

samples.question: create an Azure resource group named rg-production in East US
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use azure.azcollection.azure_rm_resourcegroup module with name: rg-production, location: eastus, and state: present.

samples.question: create an Azure virtual machine named vm-api in the rg-production resource group
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use azure.azcollection.azure_rm_virtualmachine module with name: vm-api, resource_group: rg-production.

samples.question: create a new linux user named deploy with home directory and bash shell
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use ansible.builtin.user or community.general user module with name: deploy, shell: /bin/bash, and create_home: true.

samples.question: add a cron job that runs a backup script every day at 2am
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use ansible.builtin.cron module with minute: 0, hour: 2, and job pointing to the backup script.

samples.question: taint a kubernetes node worker-02 with key env and value production using NoSchedule effect
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_taint module with name: worker-02, taints containing key: env, value: production, effect: NoSchedule.

samples.question: get cluster information including kubernetes version and available APIs
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s_cluster_info module which returns cluster version and available API groups.

samples.question: create a kubernetes service of type LoadBalancer for the analytics-backend deployment on port 80 targeting port 8080
samples.ground_truth: The playbook should use kubernetes.core.k8s module with kind: Service, spec.type: LoadBalancer, spec.ports containing port: 80 and targetPort: 8080, and spec.selector matching the deployment labels.
